starrocks.sql:
SELECT
    'id' AS name,
    CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('"' , REPLACE(id, '"', '\\"'),'"')), ']') AS examples
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT `id`
    FROM `users`
    WHERE `id` IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 3
) AS t

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'id' as name,
    CONCAT(
        '[',
        STRING_AGG(
            CONCAT('"', REPLACE([id], '"', '\"'), '"'),
            ','
        ),
        ']'
    ) AS examples
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT top 3 [id]
    FROM [users]
    WHERE [id] IS NOT NULL
) AS t

UNION ALL
